why:
The corpus declares `[serve] offline_sources`, so the search is answered from the pack's recorded fixture and says so. `answered` is the marker RFC-0048's open question 1 asked for: an identifier being a fixture's own does not tell a caller the list was not the publisher's live answer, and a server that answered from a fixture without saying so has handed an agent a list it will treat as current.

Three candidates and not four. The fixture lists four results and one has no DOI; a publisher listing something it holds no identifier for is not a candidate, and a server answering four has made one `source add` cannot take. The order is the publisher's, so the first is the first it answered.
